ValidationRule.description: A Rejected or Cancelled Purchase Requisition cannot be transitioned directly to Ordered or Partially Ordered status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ordered"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Partially Ordered")), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Cancelled")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Rejected or Cancelled Requisition cannot be moved to Ordered or Partially Ordered status. Please raise a new Requisition.
